sentences.en: Woolworth imported German-made ornaments to sell in his stores, where they were displayed on small trees made of dyed goose feathers.

sentences.en: By 1890, the Woolworth stores sold $25 million worth of ornaments annually.Japan began producing large quantities of glass Christmas ornaments in 1925, designed especially for export.
